The goodness of God is evident throughout the Bible from Genesis to Revelation.
David committed serious sins including adultery and murder.
Despite David’s severe failures, he continued to worship God.

God does not fail His people, even when circumstances seem negative.

assumptions.text: True faith involves continuing to affirm God’s goodness despite personal suffering and moral failure.
Personal testimony carries greater weight than abstract theological argument.

Belief in God’s goodness is essential for spiritual resilience and communal worship.
The speaker’s emotional honesty strengthens the credibility of the message.
